title: Candidate shortlist
summary: Scores new applicants against your rubric with evidence per criterion and suggests a shortlist. It never rejects anyone.

inspiration.title: AI HR workflow for CV analysis and candidate evaluation

stages.title: Read new applicants
stages.does: Lists new applicants per role and reads each CV.

stages.title: Mark the rubric
stages.does: Marks each criterion met, partly or not, with a short quote as evidence.

stages.title: Score
stages.does: Turns the marks into a weighted 0 to 100 score.

stages.title: Learn
stages.does: Turns feedback on earlier runs into learning and proposals before the write.
stages.command: python3 skills/routineos/scripts/routineos.py learn --docs snapshot.json --run run.json --out learn

stages.title: Write
stages.does: Applies the run input under the write contract.
stages.command: python3 skills/routineos/scripts/routineos.py write --docs snapshot.json --run run.json --out batches

connectors.label: Applicant tracking system
connectors.purpose: Read new applicants and their CVs.
alternatives: CVs placed in the run folder with an applicant reference each
connectors.connect: Add an MCP server or connector for your applicant tracking system with read access only.
